paite: Kum sawm-le-li abei nung in Titas mah leng pi in, Barnabas toh Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou nawn hi.
heading: Paul Leh Sawltak Dangte
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

paite: Kilakna ziak a va hohtou ka hi a, Zentelte kiang a tanchinhoih ka tangkoupih amau ka va hilh a; himahleh milian deuhte atuam in ka hilh a; huchi lou in zaw athawn a tai kha hiam ahihkeileh taithawnta ka hi kha ding hi.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

paite: Himahleh ka kiang a om Titas hial leng Grik mi himahleh zeksumsak teitei in a-om kei hi.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

paite: Huai unau tak lou, aguk a pilut a omte, sal a ahon laktheihna ding ua Khrist Jesu a noplenna i neih uh enkhe ding a hong lutte ziak in ahi.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

paite: Himahleh noute a dia huai tanchinhoih thutak a bittak a kep ahihtheihna ding in amau kiang ah mitphiat kal lel leng ka kipe himhim kei uhi.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

paite: Hihna deuh min nei mahmahte bangchibang hihna nei mah le uh kei a ding in alamdanna a-om kei hi. Pathian in kuamah akhentuam kei a; huai min nei mahmahte thugen in bangmah hon behlap kei hi.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

paite: Huchih nak sang in zeksumte kiang a tanchinhoih Peter kiang a kepsak a a-om bang in zeksumlouhte kiang a tanchinhoih kei kiang ah kepsak in a-om chih athei zaw uhi.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

paite: Zeksumte sawltak hi ding a Peter a sempa mah in Zentelte sawltak hi ding in kei ah asem hi.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

paite: Huan kei kiang a piak a om hehpihna amuh un, Jakob, Kifas, Johan, khuam muanhuai leh min neite'n amau bel zeksumte kiang a hoh ding leh kou Zentelte kiang a hoh ding in kei leh Barnabas kithuahna khut taklam hon pe zawta uhi.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

paite: Gentheite ka theihgige lel uh adeih ua, huai mah hih ka tum tinten hi.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

paite: Huan Antiok a Peter ahong pai lai a demhuai mahmah a a-om ziak in amaitang ngei ah ka kalh hi.
heading: Paul In Peter Taihilh
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

paite: Jakob kiang a kipan mi kuate hiam ahong pai ma un ama'n Zentelte kiang ah an ane zel a; himahleh ahong tuntak un zeksumte akihtak ziak in pang nawn lou in akikoihtuamta hi.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

paite: Juda dangte leng alepchiah chiat sam ua, huchi in Barnabas hilhial leng alepchiahna uah pimang in a-om zou hial hi.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

paite: Tanchinhoih thutak bang in a-om kei uh chih ka theih in avek ua ma ah Peter kiang ah, "Nang Juda mi na hi ngal a, Judate om bang a om lou in Zentelte om bang a na om zawkleh bangchidan ahia Judate om bang a Zentelte na omsak teitei nak?" ka chi hi.
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

paite: Ei zaw Zentel mikhialte hilou in, Juda mi him a piang i hi uhi.
heading: Ginna Ziak A Diktansak
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

paite: Himahleh dan thilhihte ziak in mi siamtang in a-om kei, Jesu Khrist ginna ziak in siamtang in a-om zaw uh chih i thei uhi; e'n leng dan thilhih ziak hilou in, Khrist ginna ziak a siamtang a i omtheihna ding in, Khrist Jesu i gingta hi; dan thilhihte ziak in mihing himhim siamtang a om lou ding uh ahi.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

paite: Ahihleh Khrist a siamtang a om tum kawmpi a eite mikhialte i na hih nakleh Khrist khelhna omsakpa hita ve maw le! Hilou hial!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

paite: Ka thilhihsiatte ka lam nawn zel in zaw, talekpa ka hi chih ka kitheisak phet ahi ding hi.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

paite: Pathian lam a dia ka hong hintheihna ding in, kei zaw dan ziak in dan lam ah ka si khinta hi.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

paite: Khrist toh kilhden in ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita kei a, keimah ah Khrist ahing ahi zaw; tua sa a ka hin bel ginna a hing ka hi; Pathian Tapa, hon it a ka sik a kipepa pen ginna ah.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

paite: Pathian hehpihna bangmah lou in ka bawl kei, dan ziak a diktatna a om in zaw Khrist athawn a si ahi kha ding hi.
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
